title: [GMCP 203.035.M] Mastery: Official MCP Registry discovery, validation, and publication
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-035-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP consumes the official Registry API and server.json format with pagination, filters, versions, package and remote endpoints, repository metadata, caching, mirrors and offline snapshots; validates entries before trust; and can lint and publish owned servers through authenticated workflows. Yank, deletion, namespace verification, malicious metadata, stale mirrors and registry outage behavior are deterministic and provenance-preserving. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
